Command.Name: ReadEODAmountsByDate
Command.FPOperation: Provides information about the accumulated EOD turnover and VAT amounts by date

Arg.Name: EOD_Date
Arg.Desc: 6 symbols for initial date in the DDMMYY format

Res.Name: EOD_Date
Res.Desc: 6 symbols for initial date in the DDMMYY format

Res.Name: EOD_sale_turnover
Res.Desc: Up to 20 symbols for the EOD sale turnover

Res.Name: EOD_credit_turnover
Res.Desc: Up to 20 symbols for the EOD credit turnover

Res.Name: EOD_saleVAT
Res.Desc: Up to 20 symbols for the EOD VAT from sales

Res.Name: EOD_creditVAT
Res.Desc: Up to 20 symbols for the EOD VAT from credit invoices
